title: AssemblyAI Recognizer Options
description: AssemblyAI-specific STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'assemblyai'.

apiKey.description: AssemblyAI API key. Overrides credentials configured in jambonz.

speechModel.description: AssemblyAI speech model to use for recognition, e.g. 'universal-3-6-pro', 'universal-3-5-pro' or 'u3-rt-pro'.

minEndOfTurnSilenceWhenConfident.description: Minimum silence duration (milliseconds) to trigger end-of-turn when confidence is met. Default: 400.

maxTurnSilence.description: Maximum silence duration (milliseconds) before forcing end-of-turn. Default: 1280.

minTurnSilence.description: Minimum silence duration (milliseconds) before allowing end-of-turn.

keyterms.description: List of key terms to boost in recognition.

prompt.description: Prompt to guide the recognition model.

inactivityTimeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for inactivity before closing the stream.

languageCodes.description: Languages to bias transcription toward (e.g. ['en', 'es']); code-switching among them is still allowed. Universal-3.5 Pro and Universal-3.6 Pro only. Default: all supported languages.

voiceFocus.description: Isolate the primary voice and suppress background noise before transcription. Use 'near-field' for phones and headsets, 'far-field' for distant microphones. Default: off.
